text:
Estimates for each item:

- Banana: about 100 g edible, 90 kcal
- Strawberries: about 80 g, 25 kcal
- Milk, a ~200 ml bottle that looks nearly full: about 180 g, 90 kcal (semi-skimmed)
- Porridge: about 200 g, 140 kcal
- Toast, 1 slice: about 40 g, 100 kcal
- Mushrooms: about 60 g, 15 kcal, plus a little oil, call it 40 kcal
- Grilled tomato: about 80 g, 30 kcal
- Avocado: about 60 g, 100 kcal
- Lemon: about 10 g, 3 kcal
- Coffee or tea with milk: about 100 g, 20 kcal
- Butter portion: about 10 g, 70 kcal
- Jam or honey portion: about 15 g, 40 kcal
- Sugar sticks: 2 × 3 g, about 24 kcal (the packets may be sweetener, but I counted them as sugar)

Calories sum to about 770 kcal.

Mass: 100 + 80 + 180 + 200 + 40 + 60 + 80 + 60 + 10 + 100 + 10 + 15 + 6 = 941 g. I rounded this to about 940 g.

{"kcal": 770, "mass_g": 940}
